title: bug: CKA_APPLICATION silently truncated in C_CreateObject
description: C_CreateObject() in wp11_pkcs11.c silently truncates CKA_APPLICATION values longer than sizeof(g_keys[gi].application) without returning an error. PKCS#11 has CKR_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_INVALID for this. A caller that sets a long application label gets no error, but the stored label is different from what was passed. Find operations using the full label then silently fail to match. Fix: return CKR_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_INVALID if app_val_len exceeds the field size, rather than silently truncating.
